about: How the composer chooses among a move's facts. Fitted JOINTLY on the hand-written Watch beats (which facts each writer used and led with, 8 courses written in the Danya style sheet) and on Danya's notes (the bench dump, 2,488 notes), by scripts/bench/fit-writer-policy.py --danya <dump> with DANYA_W=3: coordinate descent over the second job's floor and gap, the news margin, a bar per step and one offset per computer, on half the courses and half his videos; scored on the other halves, never tuned on. Danya weighted 3x because the writers and Danya disagree on the lead (the writers lead with the move's job ~45% of beats, Danya ~17-20%): at 1x the writers' lead match rose 31% -> 49% but Danya's fell 32% -> 29%; at 3x Danya holds and the turn falls to his length. One idea offset on top of the computers': the board teacher's centre reading ("covers f4, holding back their f-pawn") at -30, which opened Review turns ahead of the move's real teaching at the fitted floor (reviewMoveThought.test); held out it beats raising the floor to 40 on both sets.
